sales_goal: Convert qualified inbound leads into booked demos and prevent late-stage proposals from stalling.

field_map.transform: Match to existing CRM picklist values.

assignment_rules: All other territories -> Inbound SDR Queue

message_templates.subject: Thanks for requesting a demo
message_templates.body: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for requesting a demo. Use this link to book time with {{owner_name}}: {{calendar_link}}.
New qualified lead: {{first_name}} {{last_name}} from {{company}}. Owner: {{owner_name}}. CRM: {{crm_link}}.

message_templates.subject: Any questions about the proposal?
message_templates.body: Hi {{first_name}}, checking in on the proposal. Reply here or book time with {{owner_name}} if you want to review it together.

test_records.name: Happy path demo request
test_records.input_summary: Qualified lead with valid work email, company, employee count, and territory.
test_records.expected_result: CRM contact and deal are created, owner is assigned, prospect email is sent, Slack alert is posted, and SLA task is created.

test_records.name: Disqualified small company
test_records.input_summary: Lead has valid email but employee count is 10.
test_records.expected_result: Lead is marked disqualified and no demo booking email is sent.

test_records.name: Missing email error
test_records.input_summary: Lead has name and company but no email address.
test_records.expected_result: Workflow stops and sends a message to Slack: #sales-automation-alerts.
